items.t: Why AstraZeneca Could Make Sense Through ETFs Now
items.sum: Owning AstraZeneca directly means your results lean heavily on what happens to that single business. Simply Wall St highlights that the group has a high level of debt, and that late stage research such as the large transthyretin cardiomyopathy trial for Wainua can still fall short. Holding AstraZeneca through a fund that also owns many other companies can dilute how much those specific risks sway

items.t: AstraZeneca Extends Tempus AI Partnership with $200 Million Commitment as Analyst Weighs Multiples
items.sum: AstraZeneca commits $200 million to Tempus AI in a master services agreement renewal through 2031, while William Blair maintains a Market Perform rating.

items.t: AstraZeneca PLC (NYSE:AZN) as a GARP Case Study: Growth at a Reasonable Price
items.sum: AstraZeneca passes Peter Lynch GARP screens with steady EPS growth, a PEG near 1, strong ROE, but narrow liquidity and limited leverage headroom.
